training_objective: Per-observation squared residual + factor_L2*(||p||2+||q||2) + bias_L2*(bu2+bi2); fixed train mean. SGD, simultaneous copied p/q updates, Gaussian residual initialization0,.05.
fold_in: A=[Q_known,1]; z=rating_known-train_mean-item_bias_known. solve(A.T A+n*diag(factor_L2,...,bias_L2*shrink)) theta=A.T z. Item Q/bias/mean frozen. Missing support/item=>original component fallback.
score: Unchanged clip[0,1] then original alpha C+(1-alpha) MF and missing-component fallback. No fitted calibration; alpha0 keeps fallback.
additional_gate: Only if initial4factor best mean NDCG strictly exceeds original Hybrid, train4factor bias_L2=.001,.1; then one8factor model with best4factor bias_L2. Same9 support-shrink/alpha policies per model. Otherwise stop new fits.
selection: Bias candidate must strictly beat original Hybrid mean NDCG. Among eligible rank by mean NDCG, Recall, HitRate; ties prefer fewer factors, default bias regularization/shrinkage and original alpha. Else keep original Hybrid.
cv: Exact V26 50 developers,40train/10eval, same Support/held-out,479. Reserved25 and background255 labels not decoded; V24 outputs forbidden.
final_artifact: One refit of selected policy on all50 developers after CV selection, no evaluation on those same training users.
independent_final: NOT_EVALUATED; repeated developer CV is not independent generalization validation.
